fixes.title: Target header card under-reports planned exposures and integration time by the loop multiplier
fixes.summary: Three layers, all pinned by reverts I ran myself rather than inherited. (1) The IDLE plan line the finding reproduced was already correct on arrival: TargetHeaderCard._calculateTargetPlan delegates to plannedCaptureUnder in packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/sequencer/plan_math.dart:133, which compounds `mult * (node.repeatCount ?? 1)` for count loops exactly like Sequence._countExposures (sequence_state.dart:185-187). (2) The SAME card rendered an unfixed twin of the defect in the state the user actually watches. Mid-run the card swaps the plan line for a counter fed by targetExecutionProgressProvider, whose walk had no loop multiplier: for the Quick-Start shape (TargetHeader > Capture Loop x10 > Light x1) it returned totalFrames=1, and because a loop RESETS its children each pass the exposure node reads `success` at the end of pass 1, so the card rendered '1/1 done - 100%' after the FIRST of ten frames and stayed there all night. Same false claim, opposite and more dangerous direction (it says the target is finished). The provider walk now carries the count-loop multiplier (target_progress_provider.dart:164). (3) NEW THIS WAVE: the previous state of this fix reported `completionUnknown` for EVERY looped target, and both call sites fell back to a bare plan line, on the reasoning that the loop's pass index never leaves the Rust crate. That is true of the pass index but NOT of the frame count: SequenceProgress.completedExposures is the executor's absolute frame index, assigned once per ExposureCompleted (sequence_progress.dart:407-410) and reset per run (:291), so it is already loop-correct. When every frame the run plans sits under one target, that counter IS this target's completed count. The provider now attributes it (target_progress_provider.dart:196-209), so the Quick-Start shape shows a true '1/10 done - 10%' instead of showing no progress at all for the whole night. Two guards keep it honest and BOTH FAIL CLOSED to the plan-only rendering: `!hasUnboundedRepeat` (under a forever/until-time loop totalFrames is a ONE-PASS FLOOR, so dividing the run counter by it would re-create the exact '1/1 - 100%' defect, merely re-sourced from the wire instead of from node statuses) and equality against the model's own Sequence.totalExposures (any frame planned outside this target - a second target, a root-level calibration block, or a Smart/photometry node this walk does not count but totalExposures does - makes the run counter un-attributable).
fixes.test: packages/skotiq_core/test/providers/sequence/target_progress_provider_test.dart - 13 cases, 4 new/rewritten this wave: 'a looped target does not claim 100% after the first pass' (node status success + run counter at 1 -> completedFrames 1, fraction 0.1, not 100%), 'a looped target attributes later passes, not just the first' (identical node status, run counter 7 -> 7/10, proving the counter and not the status is the source), 'an unbounded loop stays unknown even though the run counter moves' (the inversion guard: forever loop, counter 7, one-pass floor of 1 -> completionUnknown, fraction 0), 'a looped target sharing the run with another target stays unknown'. packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/sequencer/widgets/target_header_card_plan_test.dart - 6 cases pumping the REAL TargetHeaderCard: 'mid-run a looped target counts real passes, never a false 100%' asserts rendered '1/10 done' + '10%' + '2m / 20m' and the ABSENCE of '1/1 done' and '100%'; 'mid-run an unbounded loop shows its plan, not a ratio over a floor' asserts the per-pass plan line and the absence of '7/1 done' / '100%'. packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/sequencer/widgets/run_dashboard_target_progress_test.dart (NEW) - the provider's SECOND production consumer had no test at all, and it is the panel a user watches all night; 2 cases pump the real RunDashboardTargetHeader and assert '1/10 frames' + '10%' + '2m / 20m' for the derivable case and '1 frames planned - 2m' with no '7/1 frames' / '100%' for the unbounded one.
fixes.revert_check: RAN FIVE separate reverts myself. (1) plan_math.dart:133 `childMult = mult * (node.repeatCount ?? 1);` -> `childMult = mult;`: 3 of 6 card tests failed (count loop, nested loops, mid-run). Restored -> 6/6. (2) the production WIRING at target_header_card.dart:507 `isActive && stats.hasPlannedFrames && stats.hasKnownCompletion` -> `isActive && stats.hasPlannedFrames`: the unbounded-loop case failed with 'Found 0 widgets with text "10 planned exposures - 20m"'. Restored -> 6/6. (3) target_progress_provider.dart:164-165 `childMult = mult * iterations; if (iterations > 1) childRepeats = true;` -> `childMult = mult;`: 2 of 13 failed ('count loop multiplies the planned totals' Expected <10> Actual <1>; 'a looped target does not claim 100%'). Restored -> 13/13. (4) the NEW inversion guard alone - deleted the line `!hasUnboundedRepeat &&` from the attribution condition: 'an unbounded loop stays unknown even though the run counter moves' failed (Expected true, Actual false) - i.e. the forever loop went straight back to reporting 7 frames over a 1-frame floor. Restored -> 13/13. (5) the NEW attribution block body (the three lines at target_progress_provider.dart:207-209) -> a comment: 2 provider tests failed ('does not claim 100% after the first pass', 'attributes later passes') AND the widget test 'mid-run a looped target counts real passes' failed. Restored -> 13/13 and 6/6. (6) the SECOND call site's wiring, target_header_panel.dart:357 `if (stats.completionUnknown) {` -> `if (false) {`: 'an unbounded loop shows the plan, not a ratio over a one-pass floor' failed. Restored -> 2/2.
fixes.caveats: Per-target completed frames remain genuinely underivable in exactly two shapes, and both now render the true plan instead of a ratio: a multi-target run (the run counter cannot be split between targets without the pass index, which would need a new field on SequencerEvent::InstructionProgress plus an frb_generated.rs regen) and an unbounded loop (there is no true denominator to divide by at all). Those are limits of what is on the wire, not disclosure in place of a fix - in both cases the card states the plan, which is true.

fixes.title: Every keyboard shortcut the sequencer advertises is dead in the ordinary state - including the Ctrl+Z that two delete dialogs say is the only recovery
fixes.summary: Closed by an earlier wave and still in the tree in three independent layers, each of which I pinned by its own revert. Layer 1: sequencer_screen.dart:467 wraps the CallbackShortcuts subtree in a FocusScope (not a bare Focus), so the ambient unfocus() every TextField performs on tap-away lands INSIDE the shortcut subtree instead of on the route scope above it. Layer 2: sequence_tree/node_item.dart:512 calls _rowFocusNode.requestFocus() before onSelect, so clicking a node row moves primary focus into that subtree. Layer 3: the false dialog copy is gone from BOTH sites the verifier cited - delete_node_confirmation.dart:74-79 and batch_operations_toolbar.dart:221-226 now read 'Recover it/them with Undo in the toolbar (or Ctrl+Z).' All 12 entries in the help sheet (sequencer_screen_parts/tab_bar.dart:216-227) have live bindings in sequencer_screen.dart:346-455. The one thing I ADDED: the prior note claimed layer 3 but only evidenced delete_node_confirmation. batch_operations_toolbar was correct in the tree but had no test, so a separate string in a separate file was protected by nothing; it now has one.
fixes.test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/sequencer/sequencer_shortcut_focus_test.dart - 7 tests driving the real SequencerScreen through the reported palette-search-then-click path (type 'delay' into the palette search TextField, then click the 'Lum' row, then press the key). New this wave: 'the BATCH delete dialog also points at the toolbar Undo' pumps the real BatchOperationsToolbar with a seeded multi-selection, taps Delete, and asserts the dialog body contains 'Undo in the toolbar' and not 'cannot be undone except'.
fixes.revert_check: RAN all three layers separately. (a) sequencer_screen.dart:467 `FocusScope(autofocus: true)` -> `Focus(autofocus: true)`: 2 failed ('Ctrl+Z still reaches the editor once focus has been dropped entirely', 'Alt+3 still switches tab after focus was dropped'). Restored -> 7/7. (b) deleted `_rowFocusNode.requestFocus();` from node_item.dart's GestureDetector.onTap: 1 failed ('clicking a row parks keyboard focus on that row, inside the shortcut subtree'). Restored -> 7/7. (c) batch_operations_toolbar.dart:222-223 back to 'This cannot be undone except via Undo (Ctrl+Z).': the new batch test failed. Restored -> 7/7.
fixes.caveats: Keys typed while the palette search field itself holds primary focus still go to the field (Delete deletes text, Ctrl+Z undoes typing) - that is correct text-field behaviour, not the reported defect.

fixes.title: Exposure Triggers dialog lets you add and Save a trigger, then silently discards it when the sequence has no exposure node
fixes.summary: Closed by an earlier wave and still in the tree; re-verified by revert. Triggers are a field on ExposureNode ONLY, so a sequence with no exposure node has nowhere to store them and the old write loop was a no-op while the success snackbar still fired. sequence_toolbar.dart:159-161 resolves the exposure nodes up front; :527-532 disables the bell with the reason in its tooltip ('Exposure Triggers (add an exposure node first)'); :170-180 keeps an in-function guard that refuses with an error snackbar for any other caller; :185-190 names the owning node in the dialog subtitle. I re-checked the two things the earlier note asserted rather than proved: TriggerConfigurationDialog has exactly ONE production call site (sequence_toolbar.dart:181-190), and the compact overflow rendering disables from the same `onPressed == null` (sequence_toolbar/actions_and_estimate.dart:62), so the hidden-below-breakpoint path is covered by the same gate.
fixes.test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/sequencer/sequence_toolbar_exposure_triggers_test.dart - 2 tests on the real SequenceToolbar: the no-exposure case taps the action and asserts no TriggerConfigurationDialog opens, the exposure case asserts Save lands on that node's triggers list.
fixes.revert_check: RAN: reverted the primary gate at sequence_toolbar.dart:527-532 back to the unconditional `label: 'Exposure Triggers$lockedTooltipSuffix', onPressed: canEdit ? openExposureTriggers : null`. 'with no exposure node the action is disabled and says why' failed. Restored -> 2/2.
fixes.caveats: A sequence whose only imager is a SmartExposure node still cannot hold triggers - SmartExposureNode has no triggers field in the model, so the disabled-with-reason state is accurate rather than an over-restriction.

fixes.title: Mosaic Wizard invents a camera field of view and plans the whole mosaic from it
fixes.summary: Closed by an earlier wave and still in the tree; re-verified by revert. mosaic_wizard_dialog.dart:146-151 seeds the panel size from opticalConfigProvider.fieldOfView (the same focal-length + sensor inputs the framing box uses, and null unless BOTH are known) and records provenance in _PanelSizeSource, which defaults to `unknown` (:89). With no rig the Plan summary reads 'unknown' instead of '1.00 deg x 0.67 deg' (:886-888), a keyed warning banner carries the framing dialog's own wording, and BOTH build actions are disabled with the reason in their tooltips. I also checked for relocation: the other two producers of panel geometry (mosaic_project_controller.dart:1041-1042 and plan_tonight_sequencer_helper.dart:389-399) both derive from real equipment fovWidthDeg/fovHeightDeg, so there is no second hardcoded 60x40 elsewhere.
fixes.test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/sequencer/widgets/mosaic_wizard_visual_test.dart - 'with no rig it says the panel size is unknown and refuses to build' asserts the banner, the rendered 'unknown', the ABSENCE of '1.00 deg x 0.67 deg', and onPressed == null on both keyed buttons; a sibling test asserts a 500mm/4144x2822/4.63um rig yields the real 2.20 x 1.50 deg.
fixes.revert_check: RAN a wiring cut rather than a field initialiser: replaced the opticalConfigProvider read in initState (mosaic_wizard_dialog.dart:146-151) with a bare `_panelSizeSource = _PanelSizeSource.measured;`. 'with no rig it says the panel size is unknown and refuses to build' failed. Restored -> file byte-identical to the fixed form and the suite green.
fixes.caveats: The panel size stays user-editable under Advanced, so a rig-less user can still plan a mosaic by entering the field explicitly - the gate is on GUESSING, not on planning.
